conf.comment: External net-snmp/Telegraf-style poller row of the PowerNet iemStatusProbeTable/iemStatusContactTable or Liebert-GP lgpEnv subtree (no Elastic integration, no Cribl SNMP GET source). Threshold/disconnect-transition synthesis (diffing against iemConfigProbeHighTempThreshold or a prior sample) needs a stateful store the whitelisted functions here cannot provide (join needs a pre-existing stageId); this pipeline normalizes and units-scales one sample per event and leaves synthesis to the collector or Elastic.
